brief.title: QS World University Rankings 2026: Top Global Universities Compared
brief.one_liner: A data-driven comparison of the world's leading universities according to the QS World University Rankings 2026.
brief.goal: The viewer should quickly understand which universities lead globally, how ranking methodology works, and how top institutions compare across key performance indicators.

sections.title: Top 10 Universities Worldwide
sections.objective: Present the highest-ranked universities with their overall scores and country of origin in a clear, scannable format.

sections.title: How Are Universities Ranked?
sections.objective: Explain the six core QS ranking indicators and their respective weightings so viewers understand what drives the rankings.

sections.title: Regional Representation in the Top 100
sections.objective: Show how different world regions are represented among the top 100 universities, highlighting geographic diversity and dominance.

sections.title: Key Trends for 2026
sections.objective: Highlight notable movements, emerging institutions, and shifts in global higher education competitiveness.
